# Paddles In

> An AI assistant in a pickleball group chat. Players hold their spot with a PayPal or Venmo authorization; after the game each is captured for their real share and the rest is released. Entry for the PayPal AI Hackathon 2026, running in the PayPal sandbox.

- [Live demo on your phone](https://pickle-assistant.onrender.com/demo): you organize a game from your phone while the page plays the rest of the group.
- [Source code](https://github.com/darrenR89/pickle-assistant_paypal-hackathon) (MIT)
- [For judges](https://github.com/darrenR89/pickle-assistant_paypal-hackathon/blob/main/JUDGES.md): judging criteria mapped to code.
- [Every PayPal call](https://github.com/darrenR89/pickle-assistant_paypal-hackathon/blob/main/docs/PAYPAL.md): each API, the moment that triggers it, its idempotency key and file.
- [Playground](https://pickle-assistant.onrender.com/play): a private simulated group chat with one-tap game scenarios, no keys needed.

## PayPal
- Orders v2, intent AUTHORIZE; authorize, partial capture, void, reauthorize; refunds; PayPal-Request-Id on every write.
- Payouts v1: the organizer is paid back to their Venmo (phone or @handle) or PayPal email in one payout.
- Webhooks verified with PayPal and applied once: voided holds, captures, declines, refunds, payout status.
- PayPal JS SDK buttons with PayPal and Venmo funding sources.

## AI
- Claude Haiku 5.5 (Anthropic) with forced tool calls: one parses a game setup message, one interprets every other group message.
- The model only interprets intent. All money movement is deterministic code.

## Real vs simulated in the demo
- Real: Claude, the game pages, and holds placed with a PayPal sandbox account.
- Simulated: the group chat in the demo and the other players' holds (SIM- ids). Real iMessage and SMS work when their keys are set.

## Scheduling
- Render Workflows: reminders, auto-settle, hold renewal, payout retries and recovery after a restart.
